item.title: Motorcyclist killed in crash on freeway west of Pleasanton
item.description: A motorcyclist died on Interstate 580 west of Pleasanton after an initial crash left him down on the freeway lanes, where he was subsequently struck by another vehicle during the afternoon commute Thursday, per the CHP. item.title: Man accused of stabbing roommate to death in Livermore
item.description: A Livermore man was arrested this week on suspicion of killing his roommate, who was found dead in the home they shared after not being seen for several days, police said. The post Man accused of stabbing roommate to death in Livermore appeared first on Pleasanton Weekly.
